note: Figures are quoted exactly as each post publishes them. Wealth plan posts are educational planning scenarios, not achieved results.
headlineFigureRule: Only a figure the post presents as an outcome (tax savings, modeled year-one value, net worth goal, ROI) counts. Plain income, equity and debt balances are current position, not a result, so those posts carry null instead of a borrowed number. 31 of the 61 wealth plan posts state no outcome figure at all.
taxSavingsSelection: The literal grep for "tax savings" matches 170+ generic SEO guides. Kept only posts that are genuinely a case study or a named student result. Three near misses were excluded because their headline dollar figure is an audience income threshold or a generic goal, not a result: money-moves-cpa-never-mentioned-high-earners ($200K+ earners), why-150k-year-feels-broke ($150K/year), build-10-million-10-years ($10 million).
